instruction: Can you change the time of day in this photo from what appears to be daytime to nighttime, while keeping the same lighting and visibility levels?

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because it asks to change time of day to nighttime while maintaining the same lighting and visibility levels. This is contradictory - nighttime by definition means reduced lighting and different visibility compared to daytime.
